items.title: Pick your colours
items.text: Nine colour themes (pink, teal, blue, violet, green, orange, red, gold, mono) in Appearance → Colour, and in the setup guide. Everything changes at once: me, this panel, my cards and the listening pill.

items.title: Meeting notes page
items.text: A new page under Memory: start and stop, watch the live transcript, and read all your notes like a Notion page.

items.title: Edit notes right here
items.text: Open a note to read it, tick off action items, or press Edit to change anything, then Save.

items.title: Smarter notes
items.text: ✨ Improve tidies a note (you check before saving), 📚 Flashcards turns it into a study deck, ⏰ Reminders adds its action items to your list.

items.title: Meeting notes
items.text: Say "take meeting notes" or press Start on Home. I listen the whole meeting or lecture, then write a Notion-style page: summary, decisions, action items and the full transcript, in Documents/Meeting Notes.

items.title: Everyone's their own person
items.text: Each look now has a much stronger personality: how they talk, cheer you on and nudge you is all their own.

items.title: Meet Jarome
items.text: Jaromes Lite's own study buddy: spiky hair, headphones, round glasses and a lot of hype. Pick him in Appearance.

items.title: Updates in one click
items.text: New versions now arrive from GitHub by themselves. When one's out, the button at the top says Update.

items.title: Jaromes Lite
items.text: A purple and pink study buddy, created by Vansh Bohra.

items.title: Flashcards and quizzes
items.text: Say "make flashcards from this PDF", then "quiz me". Missed cards come back soon, known ones later.

items.title: Reads your PDFs
items.text: Lecture slides, worksheets and chapters: I explain them, sum them up or turn them into cards.

items.title: Evening summary
items.text: After 6 pm I tell you what you got done, how long you studied, your streak and what's due tomorrow.

items.title: No screen viewing
items.text: This lighter edition never looks at or draws on your screen.
